metadata.description: Product discovery to PRD for product managers: research public evidence on your own repository or an example open-source product, choose an opportunity, build a clickable prototype, and write a repository-grounded PRD with an independent review.

plugins.name: nlyu-pm
plugins.description: Four commands: scout (research public sources and choose an opportunity), prototype (one clickable flow), prd (repository-grounded PRD with a read-only review), create-skill (turn one PM practice into a skill). Works on your own repository (BYOP) or five example open-source products.
